answer: Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the cipher of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The design leans on unique-model fingerprint attestation, reduced by each unverified claim, idle agents bleed standing. Work waits on the vine until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the kernel of the next round. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short.
